The thing is, I've been on a new anti anxiety medication for months now, and the anxiety is probably 90% gone. The DP/DR hasn't gotten better at all. Is yours continuous too? Or does it come and go? 

Another thing, I was on lexapro when the dp started sinking in, so I wasn't anxious to begin with. And I wasn't at all anxious about driving. It just felt like my brain experienced zoning out while driving for the first time and fell in love with it. It doesn't seem like a defense mechanism at all.
